name: OpenCode v1 AI Coding Agent in the Browser
description: Run the OpenCode coding agent 24/7 with web UI, git and a persistent disk.

OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Password for the web UI and API (HTTP basic auth, OpenCode's own server auth). Generated at deploy; the service refuses to start without it.

OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME.description: Username for the web UI and API login.

PORT.description: Public HTTP port (Caddy in front of OpenCode); the healthcheck and the public domain use it.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Anthropic API key for Claude models. You can also add providers later in the web UI or with `opencode auth login`.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. OpenAI API key. ChatGPT Plus/Pro users can log in from the web UI instead (headless device login).

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional. OpenRouter API key: many model vendors behind one key.

GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Google AI Studio (Gemini) API key.

OPENCODE_API_KEY.description: Optional. OpenCode Zen API key for paid Zen models. OpenCode's free models need no key.

GH_TOKEN.description: Optional GitHub token for gh and HTTPS git (clone/push private repos, open PRs). Use GH_TOKEN, not GITHUB_TOKEN, which OpenCode reads as a Copilot key.

GIT_USER_NAME.description: Optional git user.name for the agent's commits (default: OpenCode).

GIT_USER_EMAIL.description: Optional git user.email for the agent's commits (default: opencode@localhost).

GIT_REPO.description: Optional repository URL cloned once into /data/workspace on start (private repos need GH_TOKEN or an SSH key).

AGENT_SUDO.description: true gives the agent's user passwordless sudo (e.g. to apt install tools); false removes it at start.

OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE.description: Turns off OpenCode's update checks and notices; the version is pinned by the image and upgraded by redeploying a newer build.

OPENCODE_LOG_LEVEL.description: OpenCode server log level in the deploy logs: DEBUG, INFO, WARN or ERROR.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period for OpenCode and Caddy to stop cleanly on redeploy.
